Nora: Quick sync 	10m	1 - onboarding 'FluxPack' SKU to AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. Key gaps: final offerId, images, legal copy, and a manifest shape for infra.
Devon: I can standardize manifest. Minimal fields: offerId, sku, assets[], pricing.trial_days, recommended_instance.
Hana: Legal needs EULA + DPA snippets. Telemetry default 30 days, aggregated only. I'll drop a short clause.
PartnerOps: Staging creds in 1Password: `marketplace-flux-staging`. Uploaded AMI `ami-0f1a2b3c`, GCP image `flux-stg-2026-06-01`, Azure VHD `flux-stg.vhd`.
Devon: Infra asks for TF outputs: `publisher_account_id`, `listing_bucket`, `kms_key_arn`. Also will add `recommended_instance: g5.xlarge` (not pinned).
Nora: Decisions: trial 14 days, per-seat metered. Assets: SVG + 1200x600 PNG + 3 screenshots. Marketing blurb <=250 chars. Regions: US/EU/APAC.
LegalBot: EULA draft uploaded to Drive (link in 1Password). Telemetry clause: "Aggregated usage metrics retained 30 days; no PII exported; opt-out available."
PartnerOps: Posted offerId `redwood-flux-003`, publisher display `Redwood Inference`, sku `flux-trial-v1`. Manifest template in 1Password.
Nora: Action items: Devon - publish manifest draft to 1Password by EOD; Hana - finalize legal blurb by tomorrow; PartnerOps - confirm asset checksums. Dry-run staging publish planned Wed 09:00 UTC. Ping here if blocked. :rocket:
